resources.string: Phone sensors & Polar H10 → Lab Streaming Layer
This phone reports no streamable sensors.
Applies to continuous sensors; on-change sensors (light, proximity, steps…) stream at an irregular rate.
Microphone permission is required for the audio stream.
Tap Scan and wear the H10 (wet the electrodes) so it starts advertising.
Select a Polar device first, or switch the Polar H10 off
Bluetooth permissions are required to find and connect to the H10.
Select at least one sensor, the microphone or a Polar H10
No Wi-Fi / network: LSL consumers on other machines cannot see the streams.
If the recording PC does not see the streams, add this line to the [lab] section of /etc/lsl_api/lsl_api.cfg (Linux/macOS) or lsl_api.cfg next to LabRecorder (Windows), then restart LabRecorder:
Streams the sensors of this phone, its microphone and a Polar H10 chest strap (ECG, accelerometer, heart rate, RR intervals) to Lab Streaming Layer.
Sensorium grew out of SENDA by Ali Ayub Khan (NeuropsyOL, University of Oldenburg), rewritten with the Polar H10 support of PolarMobile.
